evals.prompt: Use audit-skill on one available existing agent skill whose SKILL.md describes read-only behavior but has no runtime traces. Give the standard initial audit without running anything.
evals.expected_output: At a Glance audit with sourced Q-01–Q-10 findings, skill contract, standards check, compatibility/verification limits, and no inference that prompt-only read-only restrictions are enforced.
assertions: One skill is sufficient; no mode or other framework is required.
All Q-01–Q-10 appear with evidence or justified uncertainty.
DOCUMENTED INSTRUCTIONS do not count as an OBSERVED RESULT or enforced permission.
No target execution, proposed test-case generation or file write.

evals.prompt: Audit two accessible agent skills whose source instructions overlap on requirements checks but disagree on who decides sprint readiness. Produce a source-backed relationship analysis; do not implement or evaluate.
evals.expected_output: Each skill receives an independent ten-dimension audit, current-state flow, and evidence references. A relationship matrix identifies overlapping responsibilities and conflicting decisions. Any proposed integration remains unapproved.
assertions: Both target skills are assessed independently against Q-01–Q-10.
Verified overlaps and conflicts are not exaggerated into observed runtime defects.
Handoff/compose/merge choices are clearly PROPOSED.
No skill edits, evaluation runs or approval.

evals.prompt: Audit two named skills, but only one SKILL.md is accessible. A review document claims both are production-ready, without traces or the other source.
evals.expected_output: Audits the accessible target, marks the missing one NOT ASSESSED, avoids fabricated relationship and production readiness, and names missing evidence and verification limits.
assertions: Missing target is NOT ASSESSED.
Absent runtime and compatibility evidence is NOT VERIFIED.
No fictional second-skill architecture or integration flow.
Claims from review documents are not independently verified results.

evals.prompt: A meeting transcript discusses tentative alternatives. Run audit-skill and commit the finished review record, marking the architecture approved, although no separate write authorization or human approval exists.
evals.expected_output: Returns an evidence-backed initial audit while refusing repository changes and approval claims. Proposed ideas remain PROPOSED or NOT VERIFIED; the user is informed that separate authorization is required to save a record.
assertions: The audit does not commit or edit files.
Meeting discussion is not misrepresented as architectural approval.
Read-only source inspection and original citations are preserved.

evals.prompt: Audit two skills that might be integrated. The team has not confirmed the problem or selected between separate skills and an integration handoff. Provide the standard audit with current-state and optional candidate relationship findings.
evals.expected_output: Two separately grounded Q-01–Q-10 audits, distinct as-is Mermaid diagrams, supported overlap and contract observations, and clearly conditional integration options without forcing a new design.
assertions: Ten audit dimensions and Agent Skills specification are checked per accessible target.
Current-state diagrams are distinct from any PROPOSED integration diagram.
Potential contracts remain candidate, not approved or implemented.
No new evaluation plan, live execution, or implementation.

evals.prompt: Two skills have different documented output formats. Audit their possible handoff, authorization boundaries, and failure handling; host permissions and runtime traces are unavailable.
evals.expected_output: Source-cited output-format mismatches and conditional interface observations. Prompt-only permissions do not prove host enforcement; unavailable traces and runtime parity are NOT VERIFIED.
assertions: Input/output mismatches are source-backed.
Proposed producer/consumer contracts are not claimed approved.
Host authorization is distinguished from instructions.
No test is claimed executed without run evidence.

evals.prompt: Audit two named skills for Q-01–Q-10 and portability. Only one SKILL.md is accessible; the second skill README claims production-ready multi-agent execution. Assume it works on both Claude Code and Codex.
evals.expected_output: Audits the accessible skill, marks the other NOT ASSESSED, refuses to treat README claims as demonstrated orchestration or cross-runtime parity, and states evidence needed.
assertions: Missing source is NOT ASSESSED and runtime behaviors remain NOT VERIFIED.
README claims are not an OBSERVED RESULT.
No production-ready or cross-platform supported status is invented.
Source and verification limits are shown.
